responsibility: This file provides general-purpose RTL inspection utilities shared across the NDS32 backend, especially by scheduling and hazard code. In the nds32 namespace it offers helpers to extract patterns, PARALLEL elements, MEM/base/offset/shift operands, branch targets and conditions, post-update information, and classification of load/store, movd44, MAC, and divmod instruction forms based on insn attributes and machine-description codes. It is the target’s common RTL-decoding toolbox rather than a pass or hook implementation in its own right.
